import pandas as pd

    "Person ID": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "Gender": ["Male", "Male", "Male", "Male", "Male"],
    "Age": [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    "Occupation": ["Software Engineer", "Doctor", "Doctor", "Sales Representative", "Sales Representative"],
    "Sleep Duration": [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    "Quality of Sleep": [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    "Physical Activity Level": [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    "Stress Level": [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    "BMI Category": ["Overweight", "Normal", "Normal", "Obese", "Obese"],
    "Blood Pressure": [126/83, 125/80, 125/80, 140/90, 140/90],
    "Heart Rate": [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    "Daily Steps": [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    "Sleep Disorder": ["", "", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea"]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert Blood Pressure to numeric values
df['Blood Pressure'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: eval(x.replace('/', ',')))

# Plot a scatter matrix to visualize the relationships between variables
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.set()
sns.pairplot(df[['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'BMI Category', 'Blood Pressure', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Sleep Disorder']], hue="Sleep Disorder", markers=["o", "s", "^", "D"])
